newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt Amex bank raises value of mutual fund.
newsitem.headline: Egypt Amex bank raises value of mutual fund.

text.p: The Egyptian branch of American Express Bank said on Monday it had increased to 300 million pounds ($88 million) from 100 million pounds the value of its mutual fund still under subscription.
Executive director Ahmed Dabbous told Reuters applicants had already asked for units worth more than 100 million pounds but he denied the orders had reached the 300-million mark.
Reuters earlier on Monday quoted a junior bank official as saying the level of subscription had exceeded the 300 million.
"We have 27,000 customers so far for the mutual fund... We are hoping to raise 300 million by the end of subscription on April 1," Dabbous added.
The fund is an income and capital growth fund investing in local and international equities and bonds. Investors must apply for at least five 100-pound units, American Express said.
The offer opened on March 18 and will close on April 1 after the minimum statutory period, Refaat said.
The fund will pay income at six-monthly intervals, in April and in October. It will be managed by Hermes Fund Management.
American Express would put 15 million pounds of its own money in the mutual fund, or five percent of the total value according to regulations of the Capital Market Authority, another banker said.
